models.name: Ternary Bonsai 2 9B
models.why: PrismML/DarkbloomAI optimization challenge on Yukon Research (cuda.fast track): Bonsai 2 9B went from 144.9 to 913.1 tokens/s on Apple Silicon in five days, and CUDA optimizations on the DGX Spark delivered a reported 401.1% improvement

engines.hardware: Apple Silicon (mlx.fast track of the Yukon challenge)
engines.quant: ternary GGUF (~2GB); decode speed only, prompt processing excluded

models.name: Ternary Bonsai 2 4B
models.why: Barron ran 32 concurrent streams of Bonsai 2 4B on an M5 Pro MacBook Pro (250 emails parsed to JSON with summaries, action items and calendar events) at under 4GB peak memory and over 700 tokens/s in total

engines.quant: ternary weights (0.95GB); 32 concurrent streams, aggregate generation over 700 t/s
